facts: POSM SecurityConfig permitAll is routing only; controllers enforce device auth.
SHA-256(token) matches exactly one active fulfillment_devices record joined to active pharmacy; token length32..256.
When supplied, claimed pharmacy is exact trimmed match; device is trimmed case-insensitive match.
Regular authenticate allows legacy only if app.posm.legacy-device-key-enabled; production compose defaultfalse, application fallbacktrue.
authenticateForUpdate accepts retired fleet key only for version route even when regular legacy disabled.
requireLegacyBootstrap is separate, requiring legacyEnabled and enrollment/fulfillment flags; not implied by update exception.
Client reuses stored protected credential only for matching device+pharmacy.
StaffAuthController ignores supplied X-Device-Id header; its device identity comes from authenticated key, while Standard-N context is separately bound.

updateTrustInvariant.algorithm: ECDSA over SHA-256, DER signature; SPKI public key pinned independently on client
updateTrustInvariant.separator: LF, no final LF after mandatory
updateTrustInvariant.archiveIntegrity: Mandatory signed SHA256 + newer version + HTTPS URL/local dev exception + executable presence; downloaded via separate HttpClient without per-device credential.
updateTrustInvariant.configSafety: Shared ZIP posm.json discarded; existing per-pharmacy configuration remains.
updateTrustInvariant.serverNote: Registration verifies signature if server pin configured; blank dev/test pin skips server cryptographic enforcement, client still enforces. Production compose requires pin variable.

facts: HTTP200 from recommend means generated payload, not visible popup.
Recommendation creation outcome=shown/shownAt is not displayedAt.
Client shown receipt originates from actual rendered/elevated visible WPF window; Windows overlay proof still required.
Recommendation shown returns ok:true for unknown/foreign event no-op: verify scoped persisted displayedAt, not response alone.
Heartbeat/fulfillment polling proves recent traffic only; monitorCount is topology telemetry, not video/popup display.
Merch QR delivery needs accepted:true (not HTTP200 alone) and correct task/token/device/pharmacy record; API cannot independently prove human attention.

EpharmApiClient uses BackendFailoverHandler: it buffers/replays even POST on network/timeout or404/502/503/504 across configured origins. All configured origins therefore must be trusted and share same authoritative data/idempotency.
Sales, outcome and recommendation shown use SQLite outbox; preserve stable ids and pending payloads.
Fulfillment versioned actions return409 after lost-success replay rather than a second transition; refetch instead of inventing success.
Legacy device registration rotates credential and must not be considered idempotent.
Human staff password/OTP API intentionally uses no automatic failover replay, no cookies, no redirects.
Merch shown queue is DPAPI CurrentUser, scoped by device+pharmacy, expiry bounded; explicit rejected capability is retired, transient response retained.
